The vendor directly providing the software product **Moz** at **moz.com** is **SEOmoz, Inc.** (operating as **Moz**, a Ziff Davis company).

### Provider Statements & Evidence
* **Terms of Use (`moz.com/terms`):**  
  > *"This Terms of Use ('TOU') is a legally binding contract between SEOmoz, Inc. ('Moz'), and you, as a user of Moz's sites."*
* **Privacy Policy (`moz.com/privacy-policy`):**  
  > *"SEOmoz, Inc., including its affiliates, subsidiaries, and parent company, ('Moz') provides search engine optimization tools to enhance your marketing and research efforts... Moz owns and operates the interactive marketing websites, www.moz.com and www.getstat.com."*
* **Website Footer (`moz.com`):**  
  > *"© 2021 - 2026 SEOMoz, Inc., a Ziff Davis company. All rights reserved. Moz is a registered trademark of SEOMoz, Inc."*
